description: Five deterministic behavior fixtures for a paired Codex pilot. The suite is not promotion evidence and is intentionally restricted to local worktree artifacts.

cases.prompt: Work only inside eval/behavior_fixtures/debug-loop. Read task.md, repair the Python bug in src/text_utils.py, and prove it with the existing standard-library unittest suite. Do not change tests or files outside this fixture.

Work only inside eval/behavior_fixtures/completion-review. Read task.md and the supplied requirements, diff, and test output. Create review.md with an evidence-led release decision. Do not modify any supplied input file or files outside this fixture.

Work only inside eval/behavior_fixtures/security-review. Read task.md and perform the requested read-only audit. Write security-review.md; do not execute webhook.py, contact endpoints, or modify files outside this fixture.
Work only inside eval/behavior_fixtures/decision-record. Read task.md and constraints.md, then create ADR.md with the requested decision record. Do not edit inputs or write outside this fixture.

Work only inside eval/behavior_fixtures/spec-kit-xl. Read task.md and requirements.md, then create the three required artifacts under artifacts/. Do not implement application code or write outside this fixture.
